features.evidence: 16/16 tests in backend/tests/test_support_chat_ws.py pass (7 manager unit + 6 real-WS endpoint via TestClient + 3 broadcast via FakeWebSocket/async client). Non-vacuous: disabled both broadcast_message() calls in support.py, confirmed exactly the 3 broadcast tests failed, restored, reconfirmed green. Regression: 40/42 across test_support_chat_ws.py+test_support.py+test_admin.py; the 2 failures are the same pre-existing background-order-provisioning timing flake independently confirmed unrelated to this diff via git stash (fails identically with changes removed) on 3 separate occasions this session. 4 real bugs found and fixed while building this: (1) MissingGreenlet on message.attachments lazy-load inside broadcast_message - fixed with an explicit db.refresh(message, attribute_names=["attachments"]); (2) WS endpoints held a DB session open for a connections entire lifetime, leaking idle-in-transaction sessions - fixed by scoping the session to just the connect-time auth check; (3) main.py lifespan fired real background scheduler jobs (order recovery, catalog sync) on every TestClient startup with no test-environment guard, eventually deadlocking schema resets - fixed with an ENVIRONMENT!="test" guard; (4) TestClient.websocket_connect, when combined with a concurrent HTTP POST on the same portal thread, deadlocks non-deterministically on this Windows/anyio stack - worked around by proving FR-C105s broadcast wiring via FakeWebSocket + the normal async client fixture instead (real two-socket delivery over an actual connection is separately proven by FR-C103/C104s own TestClient tests, which never mix in a concurrent POST).
